commit.message:
Match profanity words case-insensitively and across punctuation

ProfanityCheck split content on single spaces and compared each piece
with a case-sensitive in_array, so "Fuck", "fuck!", newline-separated
words and the default multi-word entry "screw you" were never caught.

Match each configured entry as a whole word or phrase, ignoring case and
allowing any whitespace between the words of a phrase. Words that only
contain an entry (e.g. "Dickens") are still allowed.
